name: Navigation Position Calculation
description: Verify geodetic and Cartesian position updates from sensor feeds.

name: Route Deviation Detection
description: Trigger cross-track deviation warnings when off corridor by > 2.5 NM.

name: Waypoint Processing
description: Validate sequencing and arrival estimation for flight plan waypoints.

name: Navigation Database Validation
description: Ensure magnetic declination, airway identifiers, and VOR/NDB integrity.

name: Aircraft Position Update
description: Validate 1Hz INS and GNSS fusion cycle with Kalman filter limits.

name: Navigation Sensor Input Validation
description: Reject sensor spikes, lost telemetry, and noisy accelerometer inputs.

name: Flight Plan Creation
description: Generate ICAO standard flight plans with climb and descent profiles.

name: Route Optimization
description: Compute minimum wind resistance and cost index cruise speed.

name: Fuel Calculation
description: Verify trip fuel, contingency fuel (5%), and 30-minute alternate reserve.

name: Alternate Airport Selection
description: Validate diversion runway length, approach category, and weather minima.

name: Route Constraint Validation
description: Check restricted military airspace (NOTAMs) and minimum sector altitudes.

name: Aircraft State Monitoring
description: Continuous monitoring of flight envelope, weight balance, and flap limits.

name: Altitude Monitoring
description: Track barometric vs geometric altitude and RVSM tolerance compliance.

name: Speed Monitoring
description: Indicated Airspeed (IAS), Mach number, and Vmo/Mmo overspeed alarms.

name: Engine Parameter Monitoring
description: N1, N2, EGT, fuel flow, and oil pressure threshold limits.

name: Abnormal State Detection
description: Automated detection of rapid decompression, engine stalls, and bank limits.

name: Weather Data Processing
description: Parse METAR, TAF, and SIGMET weather messages into geospatial grid.

name: Weather Update Validation
description: Validate bulletin timestamps, station IDs, and format consistency.

name: Severe Weather Detection
description: Identify convective thunderstorms, CAT turbulence, and icing zones.

name: Weather Route Impact
description: Calculate track intercept with weather cells and generate route offsets.

name: Weather Data Timeout
description: Raise warning when radar / METAR stream expires after 30 minutes.

name: Communication Link Test
description: Verify CPDLC, VHF, and SATCOM transceivers heartbeat integrity.

name: Message Transmission
description: Send ADS-C reports, ACARS packets, and clearance requests to ground ATC.

name: Message Integrity
description: Verify CRC-32 checksums, sequencing numbers, and message non-repudiation.

name: Communication Timeout
description: Detect VHF silence / packet loss and switch to backup HF/SATCOM.

name: Connection Recovery
description: Automatic re-authentication and session resumption after signal loss.
